goal: Review the bundled REFLEX reference toolkit and reproduce inspected synthetic evaluation evidence

target.description: Bundled experimental toolkit with read-only evaluation inspector
target.source: mantleos.reflex_book; exact source digest recorded per evaluation

oven.assumption: Consistent execution of sufficiently explicit recipe

acceptance: Scoped Baker review is required for each obligation. Passing local tests, prototype receipts and label metadata do not grant acceptance.

anchors.statement: Exact Book, typed IR, canonical bytes and stable refusals
anchors.test: Run golden canonical and malformed-source vectors; require exact executable JSON encoding

anchors.statement: Preserve Bool3, global guard priority, presence semantics and bounded uncertainty reasons
anchors.test: Run independent truth tables, missing/stale/future/quality/boundary cases and legacy trace comparisons

anchors.statement: Prepare once and execute repeatably without further program decoding, compilation, model calls or network
anchors.test: Execute 10000 runs with compiler/decoder/network forbidden; compare identical result and trace

anchors.statement: Bind exact candidate, source, executable, evidence and dependency revisions
anchors.test: Tamper each bound artifact independently and require refusal; pin the reviewed source handoff

anchors.statement: Keep transport, evidence, approval, installation and activation distinct
anchors.test: Refuse absent/forged/expired approval, stale baselines and authority smuggling; retain runtime reports as data

anchors.statement: Retain prior executable candidates and append audit history without replacing Body identity or memory
anchors.test: Test disable, revoke, stale quarantine, eligible rollback and failed publication preservation

anchors.statement: Recover exact canonical REFLEX candidate bytes through raw, ZIP, Cartridge and Chroma without execution or adoption
anchors.test: Test corrupt containers, independent expected digests, both digest layers and unchanged host functionality

anchors.statement: Publish measured preparation, execution and full simulated admission costs with explicit platform limits
anchors.test: Run fixed-corpus benchmark with latency, CPU, allocations and artifact size; leave model baseline and break-even unmeasured until independent data exists

anchors.statement: Distinguish checked integrity, recorded decisions, observation time, injected rule clock and host time
anchors.test: Inspect tampered and valid bounded records with evaluator, installer, operator receipt issuer and effects forbidden; compare the same observation at two clocks

anchors.statement: Explicitly reproduce exact carried inputs and executable without admission or effects
anchors.test: Reproduce NORMAL and stale UNKNOWN; refuse incompatible source or trace mismatch; test fresh installed workflow
